Robert, saw AiDash raised 50M to stand up a European HQ and grow headcount fast.

Expansion like that usually means more utility and infrastructure accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for AiDash off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Robert, quick follow-up for AiDash.

Post-raise and mid-expansion, pipeline targets usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings AiDash needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

I pulled a benchmark of how AiDash's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
